canon: Ganado de los clanes de las Llanuras (lana, leche y carne): criatura lanuda y voluminosa de cuatro patas, pelaje gris ceniza con matices rojizos y polvo rojo siempre enredado en la lana espesa que le cae sobre los ojos; cornamenta ramificada, gruesa y muy extendida a los lados de la cabeza; dientes planos y cuadrados; ojos negros con un destello amarillento. Los rebaños Serhu llevan una muesca en la oreja. Dócil y gregario, se espanta con las tormentas. Macho de pecho ancho y pesado; hembra más compacta, con la ubre visible.

prompt.sujeto: A massive, woolly four-legged grazing beast with a heavy, rounded body, short thick legs and a broad, low head.
prompt.proporcion: Its body is as long as three of its own heads, and its wide antlers span nearly twice the width of its shoulders.
prompt.ancla: a shaggy yak, only rounder and woollier
prompt.cuerpo: Thick ash-grey wool hangs from its whole body in long matted cords streaked with rust red, heavy with tangled red dust, and a dense fringe falls over its black eyes, which catch a faint yellow glint. Its muzzle is broad and blunt, and its flat square teeth show as it chews.
rasgos: Thick, pale bone antlers branch out wide to both sides of its head, each beam splitting into several blunt tines.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: A small clean notch is cut into the edge of one ear, and its broad hooves are caked in red dust.
prompt.pose: Seen head-on from a low camera angle, it stands with its weight shifted onto one foreleg and its head turned slightly toward the viewer, a tuft of dry grass hanging from its mouth.
prompt.manada: Behind it on either side two more woolly grazing beasts with ash-grey corded wool and wide pale antlers lower their heads to graze, smaller and hazier with distance.
prompt.entorno: The ground is a wide red plain of cracked earth and sparse dry tufts, with low flat-topped red mesas along the far horizon.
prompt.luz: The low sun sits on the right under bands of orange cloud and rims the wool and antlers with warm orange light, while a red-orange haze softens the plain behind the herd.

rasgos+: This male has a broad, heavy chest and the thickest, widest antlers of the herd.
This female is more compact, with shorter, slimmer antlers and a visible udder under her belly wool.

momento:dia.luz: Bright clear light falls from high on the right, warming the rust streaks in the wool and casting short shadows under the herd, while a light warm haze softens the plain.

momento:noche.luz: Under a starry night sky with a soft, even pearly glow, a cool silver-blue light rims the wool and antlers, and deep cool shadows pool across the plain.

estacion:invierno.entorno: The ground is a wide red plain of bare cracked earth with a few short dry tufts, with low flat-topped red mesas along the far horizon.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore

choque dentro del canon: la bio da una cornamenta ramificada (y el banner también) y sexDimorphism.ts da al macho cuernos largos enroscados en la punta y a la hembra cuernos cortos casi rectos; la ficha sigue a la bio y al banner, y la variante solo cambia grosor y anchura
del banner y fuera del canon: lana en cordones apelmazados como rastas con vetas óxido, cornamenta de hueso pálido, vista de frente con dos animales pastando a los lados
muesca en la oreja: canon solo de los rebaños Serhu; aquí va siempre, a falta de una variante de clan
«yak lanudo, más redondo» como ancla y las medidas en cabezas: diseño de imagen, no canon

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Del estudio: lápiz por capas a tres cuartos (lapcap) fue lo mejor; la cornamenta del rebaño se pierde si no se repite en la foto.
capas.sujeto: A single huge four-legged beast like a woolly yak, seen in three-quarter view from a low point near the ground, standing on a flat plain, its body turned to the left and its head turned towards the viewer, filling the image from the bottom edge to near the top, slightly left of centre.
capas.tamano: Barrel body, short thick legs, a broad low head.
capas.forma: Long wool hangs from its whole body almost to the ground in heavy matted cords like dreadlocks, and a dense fringe falls over its eyes. Rough antlers like weathered driftwood spread wide from its head, wider than its body, each beam branching into several long pointed tines like an old stag's. Its muzzle is broad and blunt, and a small notch is cut into one ear.
capas.entorno: Far behind it, two much smaller woolly beasts of the same kind with the same wide branching antlers graze on the plain; a far flat horizon with low flat-topped mesas and long low clouds, and cracked dry ground with tufts of grass at its feet.
capas.color: Its long wool is ash-grey and dusty, darker and dirt-brown towards the ends of the cords; its eyes are black with a yellow glint; the antlers are rough pale grey-brown like weathered driftwood. The ground is red cracked earth with dry straw-yellow grass, and the far mesas are red.
capas.repetir: The two small beasts far behind have the same wide branching antlers and long wool cords as the big one.
capas.paleta: ash grey and rust red with one accent of orange light
capas.luz: The low sun behind it on the right rims the wool and antlers with warm light while its face and chest stay in shadow, and a red haze softens the far plain.

forma+: This male has a broad, heavy chest and the thickest, widest antlers of the herd.
This female is more compact, with shorter, slimmer antlers and a visible udder under her belly wool.
